environment at instant

  • CURIE: gmeow:environmentAtInstant
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/environmentAtInstant
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/sensory-environment

The instant at which this point-like SensoryEnvironment holds. For interval-scoped environments, use gmeow:environmentDuringInterval instead.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:SensoryEnvironment -> gmeow:Instant

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:environmentAtInstant from gmeow:SensoryEnvironment to gmeow:Instant when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:SensoryEnvironment, gmeow:Instant
